SMTO-SKL-0148 — The Slack connection name isn't valid

GUID: 14706cf9-2773-537a-899a-360aaa06d5ae
Slug: slack-parameter-reference-invalid
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: slack

What happened

  • SMTO finds your Slack settings by their exact saved name. The name used here has capital letters, spaces or other characters that saved names can't have, so SMTO couldn't look it up.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open the Parameter Store page from the navigation menu and find your Slack OAuth App or Slack Workspace entry. Note its exact name, for example slack_app. SMTO looks up Slack settings only by that exact saved name, not by a display name.
  2. Ask the Agent again and give that exact name, for example 'connect Slack using slack_app'. Using the saved name lets SMTO find the right Slack app or workspace.
  3. If you're choosing a new name for a Slack connection, use only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and dots, with no spaces. Saved names with capitals, spaces or dashes can't be used.

What success looks like

  • The Agent finds your Slack app or workspace and continues with the request.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO or your Slack connection. Don't paste any Slack secret or token into the conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A Slack Parameter Store reference (auth_app_ref, workspace_ref or workspace_key) failed canonical key parsing: keys must be 1-160 characters of a-z, 0-9, '_' or '.', starting with a letter or digit, optionally prefixed with '@'.

What this means

  • Slack Parameter Store key parsing rejects the reference format. The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Slack Parameter Store key parsing rejects the reference format.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the canonical key and optional leading @ without including secret values.

How to fix it

  • Use the exact normalized key of the slack_oauth_app or slack_workspace record as shown in Parameter Store (for example slack_app or work_slack), optionally with a leading '@'. Display names and names with uppercase letters, spaces or hyphens are not accepted.
  • Pass an exact canonical Parameter Store key, optionally prefixed with @.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect exact provider state and authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • The exact intended saved profile reference resolves.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • The diagnostic performs no Slack request. Inspect the original receipt and operation stage to determine effects; keep workspace, principal and exact channel/message identities fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
